latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI Software skill.

- Upload and edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) using AI-powered cloud rendering.
- Automatically trims, polishes, and exports 1080p MP4 files—ideal for content creators and marketers.
- Cloud processing takes 1–2 minutes per video; shorter clips (<2 min) process faster and with more accurate edits.
- Supports video uploads, export/download, timeline preview, and common editing requests (e.g., cutting pauses, adding transitions).
- User authentication with free trial token (100 credits valid for 7 days); session management included.
- Clear error feedback for expired tokens, file size/format issues, and credit limitations.
